attacks.name: Rob
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand. Choose all Technical Machine and Pokémon Tool cards there and put them into their deck. Your opponent shuffles the deck afterward.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Sharp Stinger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Tickling Vines
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard 1 Water Energy card attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack. Remove all damage counters from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a basic Energy card. Show those cards to your opponent, and then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Collect Fire
attacks.text: If there are any Fire Energy cards in your discard pile, flip a coin. If heads, attach 1 of them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Apricorn Forest
cards.text: Once during each player's turn (before attacking), if that player's Bench isn't full, that player flips a coin. If heads, that player shows their opponent a basic Energy card from their hand. Then, that player searches their deck for a Basic Pokémon card of the same type (color) as the revealed Energy card and puts it onto their Bench (your ruling: not a Baby Pokémon). The player shuffles their deck afterward.

cards.name: Darkness Cube 01
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Darkness Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Plunder
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard any Trainer cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Fighting Cube 01
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Fighting Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Violent Rage
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Fire Cube 01
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Fire Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.name: Forest Guardian
cards.text: Shuffle your deck. Then, look at the top 7 cards of your deck. Choose 1 of those cards and put it into your hand. Shuffle the rest into your deck afterward.

cards.name: Grass Cube 01
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Grass Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

cards.name: Healing Berry
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool card attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card. At the end of any turn (your ruling: before Pokémon Checkup), if the Pokémon this card is attached to has 20 HP or less, remove 3 damage counters from that Pokémon and discard this card.

cards.name: Juggler
cards.text: Discard up to 2 basic Energy cards from your hand. If you discarded 1 basic Energy card, draw 3 cards. If you discarded 2 basic Energy cards, draw 5 cards.

cards.name: Lightning Cube 01
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Lightning Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to this Pokémon. Then, flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards discarded that way. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Memory Berry
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card. The Pokémon this card is attached to can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon card or any Evolution card from which the Pokémon evolved. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.) Discard this card at the end of any turn the Pokémon attacks.

cards.name: Metal Cube 01
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Metal Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Metal Reversal
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Pokémon Fan Club
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Baby Pokémon and/or Basic Pokémon cards and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (Aquapolis's own card, not a print of the newer Pokémon Fan Club.)

cards.name: Pokémon Park
cards.text: Once during each of their turns, whenever a player attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Benched Pokémon, they remove 1 damage counter, if any, from that Pokémon (your ruling: attaching to an undamaged Pokémon doesn't use it up).

cards.name: Psychic Cube 01
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Psychic Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Psy Confuse
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.name: Seer
cards.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck. Take all Basic Energy cards you find there, show them to your opponent, and then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Super Energy Removal 2
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, discard all Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon. If both are tails, discard all Energy cards attached to your Active Pokémon. If 1 is heads and 1 is tails, this card does nothing.

cards.name: Time Shard
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool card attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from the Defending Pokémon's attack during your opponent's turn, you may return up to 2 basic Energy cards attached to that Pokémon to your hand.

cards.name: Town Volunteers
cards.text: Take 5 Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, Evolution, and/or basic Energy cards from your discard pile and then show them to your opponent. Shuffle them into your deck.

cards.name: Traveling Salesman
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Technical Machine and/or Pokémon Tool cards, show them to your opponent, and then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Undersea Ruins
cards.text: Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player chooses 1 of their Evolved Pokémon in play and discards the top Evolution card from that Pokémon, devolving it.

cards.name: Power Plant
cards.text: Once during each of their turns, a player may discard a basic Energy card from their hand. If that player does, they choose a basic Energy card from their discard pile, show it to their opponent, and then put it into their hand. (Aquapolis's own card, not a print of the newer Power Plant.)

cards.name: Water Cube 01
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Water Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Splatter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness or Resistance.

cards.name: Weakness Guard
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard it at the end of your opponent's next turn. As long as this card is attached, this Pokémon has no Weakness.

cards.name: Boost Energy
cards.text: Boost Energy can be attached only to an Evolved Pokémon. Discard Boost Energy at the end of the turn it was attached. Boost Energy provides [C][C][C] Energy. The Pokémon Boost Energy is attached to can't retreat. When the Pokémon Boost Energy is attached to is no longer an Evolved Pokémon, discard Boost Energy.

cards.name: Crystal Energy
cards.text: Crystal Energy provides 1 Energy of all types (colors) of basic Energy cards attached to the Pokémon Crystal Energy is attached to (your ruling: 1 Energy that can be any 1 of those types). If there are no basic Energy cards attached to the Pokémon Crystal Energy is attached to, Crystal Energy provides [C] Energy.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Water, Lightning, or Psychic basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, this Pokémon's type (color) becomes the same as that Energy card type until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Aquabomb
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself. (Don't apply Weakness or Resistance when this Pokémon damages itself with this attack.)

attacks.name: Dual Burn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each tails, discard 1 Energy card attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Grass, Lightning, or Fire basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, this Pokémon's type (color) becomes the same as that Energy card type until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Rolling Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
